keyFeaturesAndFixes: Introduces server-authoritative reviewable answer validation with unknown answers shown as Needs review instead of automatically invalid.
Adds word validation cache, enrichment job queue, enrichment monitoring events, and authenticated local Supabase Edge Function worker support.
Moves Check meaning onto the same Supabase validation path used by scoring, avoiding phone-side dictionary split-brain.
Requires live answer submissions to match the room category set, storing missing categories as blanks and rejecting forged category keys.
Reclaims expired running validation-enrichment jobs and applies bounded retry backoff after provider failures.
Adds diacritic-aware answer normalization and explicit source-precedence coverage for African and international names and places.
Live Brawl matchmaking now fills five total seats through sequential 650ms real-player search windows.
Committed bot seats are permanent and cannot be replaced by late real-player joins.
Server-side room advancement adds at most one bot per expired search window and starts the match only at five total seats.
Round timer stays visible as a floating sticky timer while players scroll through the answer screen.
Client and Supabase matchmaking targets are aligned at five total seats.
Solo human Live Brawl rounds against bot-filled seats now receive server-authored answer verdicts and points instead of finishing at zero.
